text:
maya: Heads-up — planning to publish SDKs in today's change window (16:00 PST). Target artifacts: python package redwood-inference==1.4.0 (wheels + sdist) and npm @redwood/inference-js@1.4.0. Stagger plan: npm canary -> npm stable -> pypi wheels -> docs release. Any blockers or hold requests?

jonah: @maya can we hold the manylinux wheels until we validate the Windows wheel checksum? last time windows CI produced a different checksum on installers and it caused pip to fail for a subset of users.

maya: noted. I want to avoid a full rollback mid-window. what's the risk/time to re-build windows wheel?

samir: Rebuild is ~10m, but the problem last time looked like a packaging toolchain nondeterminism (build env var leaking). I can run an isolated rebuild and compare checksums. If mismatch, retag with -hotfix or repack.

kelly: We should also pin the old sync client by default in the docs for one rollout cycle and add a deprecation blurb in the changelog. Several customers rely on sync client behavior. :warning:

deploy-bot: npm publish started for @redwood/inference-js@1.4.0-canary. CI: green. dist-tag "canary" set to 1.4.0-canary.

jonah: good to push npm canary. we can smoke test TS SDK in staging before stable.

maya: do it. I'll hold PyPI until we confirm wheel checksums. tagging plan: git tag v1.4.0 after npm stable success.

deploy-bot: npm publish completed for @redwood/inference-js@1.4.0-canary. smoke tests triggered: smoke-sdk-tests/staging -> failed on one test (chat streaming latency), investigating.

kelly: we can still merge changelog and docs updates; just gate the PyPI publish.

samir: executed isolated windows wheel build: checksum 7f3a2b... differs from linux built wheel checksum 3d9c8e... Looks like the .dist-info RECORD has different ordering. Repro: environment var LANG=C doesn't fully unify.

jonah: ugh. known python packaging pain. Options: 1) normalize by rebuilding on the same base image (fast), 2) repack sdist and build wheel in CI to produce deterministic output (longer), 3) ship sdist only and delay wheel. Thoughts?

maya: preference: short-term, rebuild windows wheel in a hermetic container to match linux ordering; if that fails, ship sdist only and announce wheels delayed. We need an action plan and comms.

samir: I'll spin hermetic build now (using manylinux2014 + pinned setuptools/wheel). ETA 12 minutes. I'll post checksum diff when done.

deploy-bot: build-runner/1234 started: hermetic-manylinux2014 build for redwood-inference==1.4.0.

jonah: re: docs and deprecation — I'll add a note in migration.md and the release notes draft so support has copy for customers.

samir: hermetic build finished. new windows wheel checksum matches linux wheel checksum 3d9c8e... Good. I reran pip install test in a clean VM: install succeeded and import tests pass.

maya: great. status: npm canary published; npm stable planned after smoke fix. PyPI wheels rebuilt hermetically and validated. Next steps: 1) jonah to finish docs + changelog; 2) maya will trigger npm stable and then git tag v1.4.0; 3) deploy-bot to publish PyPI artifacts (twine upload) after tagging; 4) kelly to push deprecation note and pin guidance.

kelly: ack. I'll add the deprecation blurb and the "pin old sync client" snippet in docs with example: `pip install redwood-inference==1.3.2` and a note to prefer async client by default.

deploy-bot: scheduled action: will run twine upload after receiving tag v1.4.0 and artifact path /builds/redwood-inference/1.4.0/dist.

jonah: PR #482 (release notes + migration docs) is up for review.

maya: let's keep the window tight. If any of the above fails (smoke tests or twine error), we will rollback npm by `npm dist-tag add @redwood/inference-js@1.3.2 latest` and hold PyPI. Otherwise proceed.

samir: smoke test failure (streaming latency) was a flaky test — re-ran, now green.

deploy-bot: npm publish started for @redwood/inference-js@1.4.0. CI green.

deploy-bot: npm publish completed for @redwood/inference-js@1.4.0. dist-tag "latest" set to 1.4.0. smoke-sdk-tests/staging -> passed.

maya: tagging v1.4.0 now. git push --tags.

deploy-bot: git tag v1.4.0 created by maya.

deploy-bot: twine upload started for redwood-inference==1.4.0 -> PyPI.

deploy-bot: twine upload completed. wheels + sdist available on PyPI.

kelly: pushing docs and deprecation note now. I'll also add the pin snippet to release notes so support can reference it.

maya: closing loop — release completed. action items: monitor support channels for regressions for 24h, samir to file a small CI job to enforce hermetic wheel ordering, jonah to merge PR #482, kelly to publish deprecation note. Thanks everyone :tada:

jonah: ack. I'll keep watch on slack support channel and escalate if needed.

samir: filing issue with CI recipe and adding hermetic build job.

deploy-bot: release-metrics job queued: monitor token consumption and install telemetry for next 24h.

maya: marking this thread resolved. If anything goes sideways ping me directly.
